note: County of Warner campground on the south shore of Milk River Ridge Reservoir, about 20 minutes from Raymond: power and unserviced sites, boat launch, beach, playground, camp kitchens and a canteen. --Claude
summary: County-owned (local) confirmed; county page says 'CLOSED FOR THE SEASON'. No current rate, booking channel or season found on any official page; no fields written. Note rewritten (drops the unsupported 'reservable online'). Waterfront downgrade to lakeview recommended; campridgepark.ca is now a loan-spam site.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront - recommend lakeview): on Esri imagery (summer, reservoir near full, 0.56 m/px) the beach and day-use point take the shoreline; the nearest RV pads (the angled pull-through cluster in the north loop, and the east-loop sites) sit about 65-80 m from the water line, with the loop road, grass and a tree belt between; the west-side sites by the boat-launch channel are about 40-65 m from the water behind trees and the road. No pads stand within about 50 m on open ground. No statement on reservoir levels was found on the county pages. Recommend lakeview (water visible across the beach from the outer sites); I have not changed it.

BOOKING (stored reservable true, derived from note prose - left alone): no booking engine or reservation statement found. The county page lists phone 403-393-4341, email camp.ridgepark@gmail.com, Instagram @camp.ridgepark and Facebook 'Camp Ridge Park'; the Camp Ridge Park Facebook profile (facebook.com/campridgepark, latest visible post July 25, 2025) shows no booking details logged out; Let's Camp has no matching camp. Recommend clearing reservable unless the reviewer has a source.

RATE (none stored): the older Facebook page facebook.com/ridgeparkcampground (latest visible post May 17, 2023; email ridgepark17@gmail.com) has an undated intro 'Camping Power $30, Non-Power $20, Day-use $10/vehicle'. RV Life's stored avg_rate is 22 (park record updated 2021). Neither is dated 2024+ or from the current operator, so no fees written. Local campground, so no price gate.
STATUS: the county page heads the section 'Ridge Park Campground - CLOSED FOR THE SEASON' (read 2026-11-10, i.e. the normal winter closure); not written as a status change.
SEASON (stored derived Apr 15 - Oct 15 - left alone): only Travel Alberta (third-party listing) says 'open from mid-April to mid-October'.
SITES: Travel Alberta says '60 campsites, including 37 with power, and ... four camp kitchens' - third-party, not written.

WEBSITE: stored county page answered 200. The domain campridgepark.ca (cited in the stored inclusion evidence) now redirects to cupe2111.ca, a Quebec payday-loan site - never cite it. Travel Alberta's 'Visit Website' goes to the old Facebook page.
